dedupe_keys.name: fives prosim prosimplus process simulation software

description: Commercial process simulation and optimisation software for the chemical process industries. The Fives ProSim site says ProSimPlus simulates plant behaviour, tests new configurations and finds optimal solutions, is now also available in Python, and that Simulis Thermodynamics offers thermodynamic modelling in Excel, alongside process engineering studies and training courses. It is sold commercially, with prices on request. Coverage is process plants worldwide. Caveats: it is proprietary and the page read gives no licence or price. For simulation it models plants under changed feed, utility or equipment conditions for disruption, energy efficiency and decarbonisation studies. A related catalogue record is CHEMCAD.
